tooltip.starfall_blueprint.best_stride_m: Assemble manually at the workbench; install one on a main-hand frame. Defaults to Sprint mode. Requires personal Field Servicing (level 3) and Light Mobility.
Stride mode: +0.4 step height. Standing ready on ground also costs 24 XH/t and 4 heat/t (2 net after cooling); 1 wear per 100 work ticks.

Stride mode consumes power even while standing on ground. Switch to Sprint at the workbench or unequip to stop. Removal requires inventory space and preserves frame energy, heat, wear, name and work ticks.

lc.research_description.blackdog_basics: Unlock eight tier I chassis and a basic core. Each body part has 2 interface points. Core load budget: 12.

lc.research_description.micro_reactor: Unlock tier III chassis with 6 interface points and tier III functions. Core load budget: 40.

lc.research_description.aquatic_support: Provides water breathing. Requires tier I head chassis and 1 interface point.

lc.research_description.optical_cloak: Conceals the wearer and armour. Requires tier III back chassis and 3 interface points.
lc.research_description.laser_emitter: Unlock laser components and fire control. Uses 2 hand interfaces; weapons are selected independently.
lc.research_description.missile_pod: Missile launcher requires tier II shoulders and 2 interface points. Operated through fire control.
lc.research_description.mining_cannon: Penetrating mining cannon requires tier III hands and 3 interface points.
lc.research_description.floating_turret: Automatically engages visible hostile targets. Requires tier III shoulders and 3 interface points.
